title: The impulse_resolution_metrics table needs to record which vessel produced each metric. Add a mandatory text column name
description:
The impulse_resolution_metrics table needs to record which vessel produced each metric. Add a mandatory text column named producer_vessel to that existing table, in a new migration file repos/activity-api/sql/migrations/208-impulse-metrics-producer-vessel.surql.

The table is already defined elsewhere and must keep all its current columns. Only the one new column is being added, and it must always be populated.
